name: Even in Sorrow, a Black Lily Blooms
source:
After losing her parents at a young age in a car accident, Mary Miller loses all motivation to do anything. Even after her brother, who looks after her, continues to worry about her well-being, Mary goes through her days simply waiting for time to pass.

Years later, Mary finally realizes that she has stopped feeling any sort of excitement for anything at all. Just when she begins to question why she's even alive, she receives a strange video involving hypnosis that was sent to her from an old friend. The video stirred feelings inside her that she thought were long gone, and time begins to move for her again.​

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/WaifusAndSyrup]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
玛丽·米勒年幼时在一场车祸中失去了双亲，从此对任何事都提不起劲。照顾她的哥哥一直担忧着她的状况，但玛丽依旧只是日复一日地任时间流逝。

多年后，玛丽终于意识到，自己已经无法再对任何事感到兴奋。就在她开始质疑自己为什么还活着时，一位老朋友发来了一段与催眠有关的奇怪视频。视频唤醒了她以为早已消失的感受，她的时间也终于再次开始流动。
